atoms.exact_source_text: v0.5 defines player-visible concepts, persistent state, major-system interactions, and authoring obligations.
atoms.normalized_claim: v0.5 defines player-visible concepts, persistent state, major-system interactions, and authoring obligations.

atoms.exact_source_text: It does not numerically tune those systems or resolve the formal win condition.
atoms.normalized_claim: v0.5 does not numerically tune those systems or resolve the formal win condition.

atoms.exact_source_text: Conservation of System: new content must use existing Registers, state, and resolution grammars wherever possible.
atoms.normalized_claim: Conservation of System: new content must use existing Registers, state, and resolution grammars wherever possible.

atoms.exact_source_text: Named lives matter: Citizens, ownership, provenance, relationships, and memory remain visible rather than collapsing into anonymous bonuses.
atoms.normalized_claim: Named lives matter: Citizens, ownership, provenance, relationships, and memory remain visible rather than collapsing into anonymous bonuses.

atoms.exact_source_text: Asymmetry is permitted where species, Role, or ecology genuinely differ
atoms.normalized_claim: Asymmetry is permitted where species, Role, or ecology genuinely differ.

atoms.exact_source_text: symmetric complexity is not a goal.
atoms.normalized_claim: Symmetric complexity is not a goal.

atoms.exact_source_text: No hidden currencies, covert meters, generalized decay layers, or bespoke minigames are introduced without necessity.
atoms.normalized_claim: No hidden currencies, covert meters, generalized decay layers, or bespoke minigames are introduced without necessity.

atoms.exact_source_text: “Margin” is reserved for the World Zone.

atoms.exact_source_text: Capacity surplus is never called Margin.
atoms.normalized_claim: Capacity surplus is never called Margin.

atoms.exact_source_text: Home remains the center of civic management and emotional continuity.
